title: Evaluation Metrics in the Era of GPT-4: Reliably Evaluating Large Language Models on Sequence to Sequence Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Checking for systematic positional bias in GPT-4's evaluations by observing whether the order in which model outputs are presented in the prompt affects the scores or rankings it assigns.
Investigating whether GPT-4 exhibits a bias toward rating outputs from its own model family (ChatGPT) higher than other models by comparing its evaluation rankings against those of human reviewers.
